source_refs.note: Roman Urdu: the Chapter 1 exercise solved (PDF 23-24); MCQ keys from the text checked against the printed key (PDF 24), all ten agree; model answers with Wazahat boxes.

blocks.text: Exercise mein das multiple choice, das short (mukhtasar) aur aath long (tafseeli) sawal hain, kitab ki tarah English mein, hal ke saath. Har MCQ ke saath sahi jawab aur wajah hai; short aur long sawalon ke model jawab (poore number wale) diye gaye hain. Mushkil jagah "Wazahat" box aasan alfaaz mein samjhata hai.

blocks.prompt: 1. A computer network is:

options.text: A group of connected computers and devices

blocks.explanation: Computer network jure hue computers aur devices ka group hai jo data, resources aur services share karte hain (1.1, Summary).

blocks.prompt: 2. The device used to connect a computer to a network is:
blocks.explanation: Network Interface Card (NIC) device ko network se jorta hai; NIC ke baghair device network par baat nahi kar sakta (1.4).

blocks.prompt: 3. A network that covers a small geographical area, such as a school or office, is:
blocks.explanation: LAN (Local Area Network) chhote ilaqe, jaise ghar, school ya office, ke devices jorta hai (1.3).

blocks.prompt: 4. The topology that uses a central hub or switch is:
blocks.explanation: Star topology mein saare devices aik darmiyani (central) hub ya switch se jurte hain aur data usi se guzarta hai (1.5).

blocks.prompt: 5. The OSI model contains:
blocks.explanation: OSI model ki saat (7) layers hain: Physical, Data Link, Network, Transport, Session, Presentation aur Application (1.6).

blocks.prompt: 6. The protocol mainly used to view web pages is:
blocks.explanation: HTTP (Hypertext Transfer Protocol) web browser aur web server ke darmiyan web pages bhejta hai (1.7).

blocks.prompt: 7. The main function of a router is to:
blocks.explanation: Router mukhtalif networks ko jorta hai aur IP address se packets ko sahi manzil tak bhejta hai (1.4). Aik network ke andar devices jorna switch ka kaam hai.

blocks.prompt: 8. DNS is used to:

options.text: Convert domain names into IP addresses

blocks.explanation: DNS (Domain Name System) website ke naam ko IP address mein badalta hai, is liye numbers yaad rakhne ki zaroorat nahi (1.7).

blocks.prompt: 9. The device that converts digital signals for Internet transmission is:
blocks.explanation: Modem digital data ko transmission ke qabil signals mein aur aane wale signals ko wapas digital mein badalta hai (1.4).

blocks.prompt: 10. The topology that provides the highest reliability is:
blocks.explanation: Mesh topology mein data ke kai raste hote hain, is liye aik link kharab hone se communication nahi rukti; yeh sab se zyada qabil-e-bharosa (reliable) hai (1.5, Table 1.1).

blocks.prompt:
1. What is a computer network?
(Computer network kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Computer network jure hue computers aur devices ka group hai jo data, resources aur services share karte hain. Devices cables ya wireless signals se baat karte hain, maslan office ke computers, mobile phones aur printers.

blocks.prompt:
2. Write two uses of computer networks.
(Computer networks ke do istemal likhein.)
blocks.explanation:
1. Internet browsing, email aur social media.
2. Banks mein online transactions aur ATMs.
(Aur istemal: schools mein online classes, mobile calls aur messages, smart homes.)

blocks.prompt:
3. What is network architecture?
(Network architecture kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Network architecture computer network ka mukammal design (naqsha) hai. Yeh batata hai ke computers, servers aur devices kaise rakhe gaye hain aur data kaise bheja jata hai. Is mein hardware, software aur communication rules shamil hain.

blocks.prompt:
4. Name any two components of a computer network.
(Computer network ke koi do components ke naam likhein.)
blocks.explanation:
1. Router: mukhtalif networks jorta aur data packets ko rasta dikhata hai.
2. Network Interface Card (NIC): device ko network se jorta hai.
(Aur: switch, modem, wireless access point, cables.)

blocks.prompt:
5. What is the OSI model?
(OSI model kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: OSI (Open Systems Interconnection) saat layers wala standard model hai jo batata hai ke data aik device se doosre tak network mein kaise jata hai. Har layer ka alag kaam hai, aur yeh model mukhtalif systems ko theek tarah baat karne mein madad deta hai.

blocks.prompt:
6. Write the name of any two network topologies.
(Koi do network topologies ke naam likhein.)
blocks.explanation:
1. Star topology: saare devices aik central hub ya switch se jurte hain.
2. Bus topology: saare devices aik main cable se jurte hain.
(Aur: ring, mesh, tree.)

blocks.prompt:
7. What is a Local Area Network (LAN)?
(Local Area Network (LAN) kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: LAN chhote ilaqe, jaise ghar, school ya office, ke devices ko jorta hai. Is ki data speed tez hoti hai, yeh aam tor par aik hi idara (organization) chalata hai aur is mein Ethernet ya Wi-Fi istemal hota hai.

blocks.prompt:
8. What is the function of a router?
(Router ka kaam kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Router mukhtalif networks ko jorta hai, maslan ghar ke network ko Internet se. Yeh IP addresses ki madad se data packets ko sahi manzil tak bhejta hai aur network ki security aur control behtar karta hai.

blocks.prompt:
9. What is a network protocol?
(Network protocol kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Network protocol devices ke darmiyan baat cheet ke rules (qawaid) ka set hai. Yeh batata hai ke data kis shakal mein, kaise bheja aur pohanchaya jaye aur errors kaise sambhale jayen. Misal: TCP/IP, HTTP.

blocks.prompt:
10. What is the purpose of DNS?
(DNS ka maqsad kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: DNS (Domain Name System) website ke naam ko IP address mein badalta hai, maslan www.example.com ko 93.184.216.34 mein. Users ko numbers yaad nahi rakhne parte; yeh kaam DNS servers karte hain.

blocks.prompt:
1. Define a computer network. Explain its importance and uses in daily life.
(Computer network ki tareef karein; rozmarra zindagi mein is ki ahmiyat aur istemal batayein.)
blocks.explanation:
Tareef: Computer network jure hue computers aur devices (computers, mobile phones, printers) ka group hai jo cables ya wireless signals se baat karte aur data, files aur resources share karte hain.

Ahmiyat:
- Maloomat jaldi aur aasani se share hoti hai.
- Network ke zariye communication waqt aur mehnat bachati hai.
- Data, files aur resources aik device se doosre tak jate hain.
- Online taleem aur ghar se kaam (remote work) networks se hota hai; karobar rozana ke kaam in par chalate hain.
- Aaj ki zindagi ke rozana kaam networks par munhasir hain.

Rozmarra istemal:
1. Internet browsing.
2. Mobile phones: calls, messages aur apps.
3. Schools: online classes aur learning systems.
4. Banks: online transactions aur ATMs.
5. Social media.
6. Smart homes: devices ko network se control karna.

Network zaroorat ke mutabiq chhota (ghar) ya bara (Internet) ho sakta hai.

blocks.prompt:
2. Explain network architecture and describe the main components of a computer network.
(Network architecture samjhayein aur computer network ke main components bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation:
Network architecture: computer network ka mukammal design. Yeh batata hai ke computers, servers aur doosre devices kaise rakhe gaye hain aur data kaise bheja jata hai. Is mein hardware, software aur communication rules shamil hain. Achha architecture network ko efficient banata aur aage barhane (expansion) ki gunjaish deta hai.

Network kaise kaam karta hai: data chhote packets mein toota hai; packets cables ya wireless signals se jate hain; networking devices unhein sahi manzil ki taraf bhejte hain; receiver packets ko jor kar asal data bana leta hai.

Main components:
1. Network Interface Card (NIC): device ko network se jorta hai (wired ya wireless); har NIC ka apna MAC address hota hai; data bhejta aur leta hai.
2. Switch: devices jorta aur data sahi device ko bhejta hai; speed behtar karta hai.
3. Router: mukhtalif networks (maslan LAN aur Internet) jorta aur IP address se packets ko rasta dikhata hai.
4. Modem: local network ko ISP se jorta hai; digital data ko signals mein aur wapas badalta hai.
5. Wireless access point: Wi-Fi deta hai taake wireless devices jur saken; coverage barhata hai.
6. Transmission media: cables (Ethernet) ya wireless signals.
7. End devices aur servers (computers, laptops, phones, printers), saath software aur protocols (communication rules) jaise TCP/IP.

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Network ko daak ke nizam (postal system) ki tarah samjhein: khat (data) chhote lifafon (packets) mein jata hai, router daakkhana hai jo pata (IP address) dekh kar rasta chunta hai, aur aakhir mein saare lifafe jor kar poora khat parha jata hai.

blocks.prompt:
3. What is the OSI model? Explain its layers and their functions.
(OSI model kya hai? Is ki layers aur un ke kaam samjhayein.)
blocks.explanation:
OSI (Open Systems Interconnection) network communication samajhne ka standard model hai. Yeh communication ko saat layers mein baant deta hai; har layer ka khaas kaam hai aur data step by step in layers se guzarta hai. Layers ki wajah se network samajhna, banana aur ghalti dhoondna (troubleshooting) aasan hota hai, aur aik layer mein tabdeeli doosri par asar nahi karti.

Saat layers (sender ki taraf upar se neeche):
7. Application layer: users aur applications ko seedhi services deti hai; HTTP, FTP aur email jaise protocols.
6. Presentation layer: data ko application ke samajhne wali shakal mein badalti hai; encryption, compression aur format conversion.
5. Session layer: applications ke darmiyan session shuru, qaim aur khatam karti hai; rukawat ke baad checkpoints aur recovery.
4. Transport layer: data ki bharosemand (reliable) aur tarteeb wali delivery; error recovery, flow control aur data ko segments mein todna.
3. Network layer: data ko source se destination tak networks ke paar route karti hai; IP addressing aur behtareen rasta.
2. Data Link layer: seedhe jure nodes ke darmiyan bina ghalti transfer; framing, error detection/correction aur shared medium ka access.
1. Physical layer: kacha (raw) data electrical, optical ya radio signals ki shakal mein bhejti hai; cables, connectors, voltage aur data rate tay karti hai.

Neeche wali layers physical transfer, darmiyani routing aur delivery, aur upar wali user applications sambhalti hain.

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Layers yaad karne ka aasan jumla (neeche se upar): "Please Do Not Throw Sausage Pizza Away" = Physical, Data Link, Network, Transport, Session, Presentation, Application. Sender par data upar se neeche jata hai, receiver par neeche se upar.

blocks.prompt:
4. Define network topology. Explain bus, star, ring, and mesh topologies with advantages and disadvantages.
(Network topology ki tareef karein. Bus, star, ring aur mesh topologies fawaid aur nuqsanaat ke saath samjhayein.)
blocks.explanation:
Network topology computer network ka layout hai: devices aur cables kis tarah rakhe gaye hain. Physical topology asal connections dikhati hai; logical topology batati hai ke data kaise chalta hai. Topology performance aur maintenance par asar karti hai.

- Bus: saare devices aik main cable se jure hote hain aur data isi par chalta hai; chhote networks ke liye.
- Star: saare devices aik central hub ya switch se jurte hain aur data usi se guzarta hai; aaj kal sab se zyada istemal.
- Ring: devices aik daire (circle) mein jure hote hain; data aik hi simt mein chalta aur har device aage deta hai; ab kam istemal.
- Mesh: har device kai doosre devices se jura hota hai, is liye kai raste milte hain; bare aur aham networks mein.

Fawaid aur nuqsanaat table (Table 1.1) mein hain. Topology ka intikhab network ki zaroorat par hai.

rows: Saada aur lagana aasan; kam cable; sasta
Main cable kharab to poora network band; ghalti dhoondna mushkil; devices barhne se speed kam
Lagana aur sambhalna aasan; aik device kharab ho to baqi chalte rehte hain; ghalti jaldi milti hai
Central hub/switch kharab to network band; zyada cable; zyada kharcha
Data tarteeb se chalta hai; data collision (takrao) nahi; sab devices ko barabar mauqa
Aik device kharab to poora network mutasir; device jorna/hatana mushkil; ab kam istemal
Sab se zyada bharosemand, fault-tolerant; data ke kai raste; zyada security
Bahut mehnga; lagana pecheeda; bahut zyada cables

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Mesh mein agar n devices hon aur har device har doosre se jura ho to n(n-1)/2 cables lagti hain, maslan 5 devices ke liye 5x4/2 = 10 cables. Isi liye mesh sab se bharosemand magar sab se mehngi hai.

blocks.prompt:
5. Explain the types of computer networks. Describe LAN, WAN, and the Internet.
(Computer networks ki iqsam samjhayein. LAN, WAN aur Internet bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation:
Computer networks size aur coverage area (faasle) ke lehaz se taqseem hote hain. Har qism devices ko khaas tareeqe se jorti hai aur alag kaam aati hai; iqsam ka ilm sahi network chunne mein madad deta hai. Aam iqsam LAN, WAN aur Internet (public WAN) hain.

1. Local Area Network (LAN):
- Chhote ilaqe (ghar, school, office) ke devices jorta hai.
- Data speed tez.
- Aam tor par aik hi idara chalata hai.
- Ethernet aur Wi-Fi; sasta aur sambhalna aasan.

2. Wide Area Network (WAN):
- Bara ilaqa; mukhtalif shehron ya mulkon ke networks jorta hai.
- Leased lines, satellites ya Internet istemal karta hai.
- LAN se dheema; lagana aur chalana mehnga.
- Internet WAN ki sab se bari misal hai.

3. Internet (public WAN):
- Duniya bhar ke karoron devices aur networks ko jorne wala global network.
- Standard protocols se maloomat duniya bhar mein share hoti hai.
- Services: email, websites, cloud storage.
- Taleem, karobar aur entertainment; access ISP (Internet Service Provider) deta hai, maslan DSL ke zariye.

blocks.prompt:
6. Describe the main networking devices used in a computer network and explain their functions.
(Computer network mein istemal hone wale main networking devices aur un ke kaam bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation:
Networking devices computers aur doosre devices ko network mein jorte aur data ke bahao (flow) ko control karte hain; har aik ka khaas kaam hai.

1. Network Interface Card (NIC): device ko network se jorta hai; wired ya wireless; har NIC ka unique MAC address; data bhejta aur leta hai. NIC ke baghair device baat nahi kar sakta; aaj kal aksar devices mein built-in hota hai.
2. Switch: network ke andar devices jorta aur data sirf sahi device ko bhejta hai; speed aur efficiency barhata hai.
3. Router: mukhtalif networks jorta hai (maslan ghar ka network aur Internet); IP address dekh kar packets ko manzil tak bhejta hai; security aur control behtar karta hai. Yahi aam tor par default gateway hota hai.
4. Modem: local network ko ISP se jorta hai; digital data ko signals mein aur aane wale signals ko wapas digital mein badalta hai; cable, DSL ya fibre ke saath; aksar router ke saath kaam karta hai.
5. Wireless access point: Wi-Fi deta hai taake wireless devices jur saken; bari imaraton aur campus mein coverage barhata hai; signal mazboot karta hai.

blocks.prompt:
7. What are network protocols? Explain TCP/IP, HTTP, FTP, and DNS.
(Network protocols kya hain? TCP/IP, HTTP, FTP aur DNS samjhayein.)
blocks.explanation:
Network protocol communication ke rules ka set hai. Yeh batata hai ke data kis format mein aur kaise bheja jaye, aur errors aur delivery ko control karta hai. Network ke saare devices aik hi protocol maante hain; protocols ki wajah se data aasani se tabdeel hota hai (yeh computers ki zabaan ki tarah hain).

1. TCP/IP: Internet ka main protocol, taqreeban har network mein. TCP data ki bharosemand delivery yaqeeni banata hai; IP addressing aur routing sambhalta hai.
2. HTTP (Hypertext Transfer Protocol): web browser aur web server ke darmiyan web pages bhejta hai taake user websites dekh sake. HTTP data encrypt nahi karta; HTTPS is ka mehfooz version hai jo SSL/TLS encryption se passwords, zaati maloomat aur payment data bachata hai.
3. FTP (File Transfer Protocol): files upload aur download karne aur computers mein share karne ke liye; bari files bhi; web developers istemal karte hain; mehfooz versions bhi hain.
4. DNS (Domain Name System): website ke naam ko IP address mein badalta hai (www.example.com se 93.184.216.34), taake numbers yaad na rakhne parein; har website kholne par DNS servers yeh kaam karte hain.

blocks.prompt:
8. Explain IP addressing. Describe IPv4, IPv6, the default gateway, and subnetting.
(IP addressing samjhayein. IPv4, IPv6, default gateway aur subnetting bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation:
IP addressing: IP (Internet Protocol) address device ko diya gaya unique number hai. Yeh network par device ki pehchan hai aur data isi se apni manzil dhoondta hai. Har network device ka IP address hona zaroori hai; is ke baghair communication mumkin nahi.

IPv4:
- Purana version; 32-bit address.
- 4 numbers (har aik 0-255, yani 1 byte = 8 bits) dots se alag, maslan 192.168.1.10.
- Network part 192.168.1 local network batata hai; host part 10 device batata hai.
- Mehdood: taqreeban 4.29 billion addresses (2^32).

IPv6:
- Naya version; 128-bit address, bahut zyada address space (2^128, taqreeban 3.4 x 10^38).
- 8 groups, har group 4 hexadecimal digits (16 bits), colons se alag, maslan 2001:0db8:85a3:0000:0000:8a2e:0370:7334.
- Hisse: global routing prefix (ISP/ilaqa), subnet ID (local network), interface ID (device).

Default gateway: local network ko doosre networks se jorta hai; aam tor par router. Bahar jane wala data isi se guzarta hai aur yeh use sahi network tak bhejta hai; Internet access isi par munhasir hai.

Subnetting: network ko chhote hisson (subnets) mein baantna, maslan 192.168.1.0/24 ko 192.168.1.0/25 aur 192.168.1.128/25 mein. Is se traffic kam, performance behtar aur security zyada hoti hai, aur bare network sambhalna aasan hota hai.

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: IPv4 mein 32 bits hain, is liye 2^32 = 4,294,967,296 (taqreeban 4.29 billion) addresses. /24 ka matlab hai pehli 24 bits network ki; /25 mein aik bit aur network ko di gayi, is liye network do barabar subnets mein bant gaya (0-127 aur 128-255).
